# Cloud Agent & Copilot Instructions

- Collaborative Remote: `https://github.com/y1-community/Innioasis-Updater.git`
- Make small, atomic commits and push them regularly to `y1-community/Innioasis-Updater` so other agents and contributors stay in sync.
- Always pull/fetch from `y1-community/main` before editing.
- For internationalization and multilingual site rules, consult `I18N.md`, `I18N_TODO.md`, and `AGENTS.md`. Content changes must update all supported languages simultaneously.
